answer: Same round slot auction. Each round has limited action slots; coordinating agents must each win a non-transferable slot for that round. Slots sell by second-price auction, so simultaneous sybil demand raises the clearing price. A raven call recording seeds the round price. Dune survey data rotates the seed daily. Lotus bloom photos break price ties. An attacker pays one winning bid per fake identity per coordination round, plus delay from losing bids.
